title: Synthetic Data Generator in Data Scarce Medical Environments
summary: A research codebase for generating and validating synthetic medical data (classification and survival analysis) under data-scarce conditions, with associated preprocessing, generation, and validation scripts. Its data_manager.py imports SDV's SingleTableMetadata class to define the schema for the tabular medical datasets it processes.
needs: No explicit call site shown for SingleTableMetadata usage beyond the import; actual invocation not confirmed in evidence.
